commands.review_summary:
The PR moves superseded-run removal persistence ahead of artifact cleanup, restores the in-memory row when persistence fails, and adds a sweep-based retry path with regression tests.

PR surface: Source +35, Tests +154. Total +189 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source with high confidence: fail the old-row removal, release and persist the successor, restart, then sweep; the old row no longer has a newer registry entry that identifies it as superseded.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] The required repair crosses persisted payload shape, normalization, lifecycle ownership, and fresh-generation construction, so it should remain with the area owners rather than enter a narrow automated repair lane.
